input.brief: A standalone light theme study for EnsoCode, an Electron coding agent workbench; use the supplied white-and-green chat reference while preserving the workspace rail, project sessions, agent timeline, composer, and dockable Git changes.
screens: 编程工作台：项目会话、Agent 回复、可打开的 Git 改动面板
主题样式：颜色令牌、表面层次与控件状态

stated.mood: 以用户给出的聊天工作台截图为准：瓷白内容区、柔灰侧栏、圆润、白色浮起的选中会话、清新的绿色与浅绿色状态
stated.emphasis: 沿用参考图的清透观感，主题用于 EnsoCode 桌面编程工作台

obvious: A stock blue-gray IDE with Inter, a tree with rectangular rows, and a grid of equal boxed tool results.

proposals.name: 薄荷白
proposals.idea: On these screens, EnsoCode’s Agent turn with its dockable Git evidence becomes one mint-edged change receipt in the conversation, with the files and actual diff a click away.
proposals.departs: Porcelain white, a raised selected conversation and a single vivid green diff mark carry the user's supplied reference without turning the workspace into a messaging clone.
proposals.layout: A 56px utility rail and 276px project list, a calm conversation with one substantial evidence receipt; a narrow dock opens without covering the conversation. The appearance route uses the same window chrome.

devices.reason: User reference has a lifted active session, a rounded window and a light edge on the primary result; keep remaining surfaces flat.
The Git receipt is a single paper-like object with a barely visible top-left light and grain, not a tinted chat background.

proposals.name: 琥珀底片
proposals.idea: On these screens, EnsoCode’s parkable workflow and Git panels become a dark contact sheet for comparing one change against its neighboring tool results.
proposals.departs: A charcoal work surface, amber evidence markers and a condensed title emphasize a review-first flow with the dock expanded.
proposals.layout: The tool dock sits wide beside the thread and an always visible rail holds project switching.

proposals.name: 蓝墨案卷
proposals.idea: On these screens, EnsoCode’s local-first sessions by repository become a single chronological engineering ledger where the project tree collapses into a project switcher.
proposals.departs: Ink blue on archival sand, an editorial heading and a top switcher replace the grey IDE framing.
proposals.layout: A top project switcher leaves the left edge for timestamps; the artifact opens as a sheet beside the ledger.
